fill.title: Jobs
captions: The paste kit|stays on the phone

chapters.title: This morning’s|picks
narration: I'm looking for work, and this is where my mornings start.
A few postings wait each day, weighed against my own résumé, so the search fits before the day does.
When I pass on one, I say why, and the reason stays with it.

chapters.title: Applying
narration: Applying is where a search usually stalls, so I made it small.
Each application gets a résumé made for that posting, from one copy I keep up to date.
All of it lives on my phone and on a server in my home.

chapters.title: The interview|week
narration: Interviewing is a skill, so I practise it like one.
Each week, a made-up company sends a week of questions, and I answer them out loud, wherever I am.
Hearing myself back is the part that teaches.

chapters.title: The record
narration: Every application and every answer I've said is kept, so months from now I can see how far I've come.
I built this for my own search, and it's published as it is, for anyone to see how it works.
